answer: The fee is charged through a tundra debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the jade totals, and the pulse anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. At 22 units per epoch, sustaining 173 aliases for 33 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the copycat. A farm of 31 pays that 53 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
